objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the insecure direct object reference weakness of getTheFirst, a Node.js and MongoDB application where users register, log in, and view profiles. It shows when its first user was created and recover the flag (FLAG{...}) it guards.
hints: Note every numeric or encoded identifier the application sends, and whether the server checks that it belongs to you.

steps.title: Identify the stack
steps.prompt: Which framework or language runs the application? (name only)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which access-control weakness lets you reach another account's objects by changing an identifier?

steps.title: Identify the database
steps.prompt: Which database generates the user identifiers?
